tabs.label: append-only feed
tabs.description: Immutable facts — events, logs, CDRs. No merge, no per-row diff.

tabs.label: full replace
tabs.description: Full extract each run, small enough to recompute entirely.

tabs.label: overwrite current
tabs.description: Entity state where only the current value matters.

tabs.label: full history
tabs.description: Entity state where full history matters.

tabs.label: current + previous
tabs.description: Only current and previous value matter. Transformation flows only.

fields.label: target_config.primary_keys
fields.description: Business key(s) used by apply_changes / apply_changes_from_snapshot. Required by every CDC strategy as of v1.4.0.

fields.label: target_config.sequence_by_column
fields.description: Ordering column for CDC. Falls back to framework ingestion timestamp.

fields.label: target_config.columns_to_check
fields.description: Limits which columns trigger a new history version (SCD2) or a current/previous pivot (SCD3). Never include encrypted columns.

fields.label: target_config.columns_to_exclude
fields.description: Excludes columns from the target schema (except_column_list) and from comparison. Validation error with APPEND, TRUNCATE_AND_LOAD or FULL_SNAPSHOT_CDC.

fields.label: target_config.cdc_operation_column
fields.description: Column carrying insert/update/delete indicators. Optional regardless of primary_keys. Not applicable to FULL_SNAPSHOT_CDC.

fields.label: cdc_operation_mapping.delete_values
fields.description: Values in cdc_operation_column meaning this row is a delete.

fields.label: target_config.empty_target_if_source_empty
fields.hint: default false — an empty source leaves the target untouched
fields.description: Governs a TRUNCATE_AND_LOAD run whose source recomputes to zero rows. false (default, safe) leaves the target untouched; true truncates it to empty.

fields.label: target_config.generate_hash_columns
fields.description: Adds __framework_hash_key (SHA-256 of primary keys) and __framework_hash_value (SHA-256 of comparison columns). Never added for APPEND or TRUNCATE_AND_LOAD.
